hero.title: Every grade, one keystroke away.
hero.subtitle: Records, reports and analysis for the whole institution — with an assistant that reads the same numbers you do.

risk.query: who is at risk in Databases?

features.title: Built for the people who actually enter the grades

scoped.title: Everyone sees exactly their own
scoped.body: Students see their grades, teachers their courses, administrators everything. Scoping happens in the query, so a mistake shows too little rather than too much.

fast.title: Fast because it is small
fast.body: One file, no server to run, no cloud account. Pages arrive rendered and the whole record set fits in memory.

ai.title: An assistant that cannot guess
ai.body: Questions become real database queries. Every figure it reports comes back with the rows it came from, so a wrong answer is visibly wrong.

how.title: Three steps to a full gradebook

one.title: Import what you have
one.body: Drop in a spreadsheet. Columns are matched for you and every change is shown before anything is written.

two.title: Record and correct
two.body: Enter grades inline. Every edit is kept in the audit trail with who made it and what it replaced.

three.title: Report and act
three.body: Term reports, distributions and at-risk lists, in your language and ready to hand over.

footer.built: A coursework project, built as a product.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: Which model answers each question, and what it costs.
ai.name: Name
ai.keyEnvHint: The name of an environment variable — never the key itself. Leave empty for a local model.
ai.thirdPartyWarning: This provider forwards requests to third parties whose data-retention terms are unknown. This system holds student names, emails and grades. Use it for development, not for real records.
ai.parametersHint: A JSON object merged into each request. Conversation fields such as model, messages, system and tools are protected.
ai.routingIntro: Each feature picks its own model. The command palette wants speed; insight narratives want quality.
ai.usageIntro: Estimated cost, not an invoice. Prices change and local models are free.
ai.baseUrlHint: The OpenAI-compatible root, which `/chat/completions` is appended to. Ollama serves it under /v1, so use http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 — its native API on the bare port speaks a different protocol.

branding.gradingIntro: Bands must be unique, descend from highest to lowest, and end at zero.
